int_name: N BROAD ST & W GLENWOOD AVE

result.summary: The environment features a wide multi-lane roadway with marked continental crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like traffic signals and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distance and lack of pedestrian refuge islands increase exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large bushes on the left corner may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim or remove the large bushes near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane signalized intersection that lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure. There are no visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals, creating a hostile environment for people attempting to cross the expansive roadway.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks, which fails to alert drivers to pedestrian presence and does not guide pedestrians to a safe path.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane roadway creates a long exposure time for pedestrians without any mid-crossing refuge.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to reduce crossing distance and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with four travel lanes and marked continental crosswalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like signals and sidewalks are present, the long crossing distance and lack of a median refuge create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radii
hazards.description: The entrance to the gas station on the right has wide, sweeping radii that allow vehicles to turn at higher speeds across the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection at the gas station entrance

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked crosswalk and wide sidewalks adjacent to a transit station entrance. However, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and a wide corner radius that may encourage higher vehicle turning speeds are notable safety concerns.

hazards.name: Wide Corner Radius
hazards.description: The corner radius at the intersection is wide, which can encourage vehicles to make turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image at the intersection corner near the transit entrance.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: There are no clearly visible pedestrian signal heads at this signalized intersection to provide crossing guidance.

interventions.title: Curb Extension
interventions.description: Install a curb extension to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.description: Replace the existing parallel line crosswalk with a high-visibility continental or ladder pattern.
